description: List the table of contents styles (Inhaltsverzeichnisformate) of the document: toc_styles[] {name, title, title_style, include_hidden_layers, run_in, include_book_documents, create_bookmarks, entries[] {paragraph_style (the style whose paragraphs become entries), level, entry_style (paragraph style of the entry in the TOC), page_number_position after|before|none, separator, page_number_style, separator_style, sort_alphabetical}}, count, and toc_stories[] {story_id, frame_ids, page_ids, page_names, paragraph_count, length, overset} – the tables of contents already in the document. Every document carries InDesign's default style (localized name, e.g. "[Default]"). A style name shown in square brackets such as "[Same style]" means InDesign's default. Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: list_toc_styles
title: List table of contents styles
